user.title: Orchestra
user.description: Configure the Orchestra edge node and Conductor market broadcast receiver.

abort.already_configured: Orchestra is already configured on this Home Assistant instance.

apply_hvac_offset.name: Apply HVAC setpoint offset
apply_hvac_offset.description: Drift A/C setpoints by the Conductor offset from each unit's own starting setpoint, and restore it when the offset is 0. Safe to call repeatedly.

offset_sensor.name: Offset sensor
offset_sensor.description: The Orchestra setpoint offset sensor to follow.

invert_shed_when_heating.name: Shed downwards when heating
invert_shed_when_heating.description: Apply a load-shed offset as a drop while the unit is heating.

skip_when_off.name: Leave units alone while off
skip_when_off.description: Don't start a drift on a unit whose HVAC mode is off.

turn_on_for_pre.name: Switch on for pre-heat and pre-cool
turn_on_for_pre.description: Switch an off unit on for pre-heat or pre-cool, and back off when it ends.

apply_heat_pump.name: Apply heat pump signal
apply_heat_pump.description: Switch heat pumps on for Energy Soak and off for Load Shed, and put each back to what it was doing before on Normal. Safe to call repeatedly.

entity_id.name: Heat pumps
entity_id.description: Water heaters, climates or switches. With a power switch, these only get their temperature set and restored.

power_switch.name: Power switches
power_switch.description: Entities that switch the heat pumps on and off.

target_sensor.name: Target sensor
target_sensor.description: The Orchestra heat pump target sensor to follow.

boost_operation_mode.name: Energy Soak operation mode
boost_operation_mode.description: Water heater operation mode while soaking.
